players.name: Kai Lucas
players.bio: Current season leader and two-time major champion.
players.longBio: Kai Lucas has established himself as one of the leading players on the Travellers Tour, combining regular-season wins with strong performances in the majors.

players.name: Fletcher Gaffney
players.bio: A consistent contender known for strong team-event performances.
players.longBio: Fletcher Gaffney is a consistent presence on the Travellers Tour, particularly dangerous in team and alternate-format events.

players.name: Xavier Minogue
players.bio: A dangerous competitor with a growing record of tour success.
players.longBio: Xavier Minogue continues to build a strong tour record and has become a regular threat across the season schedule.

news.headline: Kai Lucas wins the Ampol Wolf Stroke Play
news.summary: Kai Lucas added another victory to his season and strengthened his position at the top of the standings.
news.body: Kai Lucas added another victory to his 2026 campaign at the Ampol Wolf Stroke Play. The result strengthened his position in the season standings and continued a strong run of form across the Travellers Tour season.
